Starting on 11/11/24, all in-person checkouts need to occur BEFORE 2:45 PM. Please anticipate a 20 minute wait. Due to construction on campus, several areas are closed resulting in longer times to deliver early dismissal passes to classrooms and longer times for students to walk from their classrooms to the front office. After 2:45 PM, please wait to meet your student at the normal dismissal time. Our recommendation: 1)

send a parent note with your student in the morning for them to bring to the Attendance Office before school or 2) send an email by 10:30 AM to vrhsearlydismissal@leanderisd.org so that an Early Dismissal pass can be given to your student prior to his/her desired dismissal time. This means you will avoid having to wait in line for a pass to be sent to your student and that they can simply meet you in the front of the school at the desired time–you won’t even have to step foot in the building! In conclusion: Send a parent note with your student in the morning for them to bring to the Attendance Office before school or send an email to vrhsearlydismissal@leanderisd.org by 10:30 AM so that an Early Dismissal pass can be given to your student prior to his/her desired dismissal time. Early dismissal notes/emails that are received by 10:30

AM with a dismissal time later than 2:45 PM will still be accepted. The 2:45 PM cutoff time is simply for in-person checkouts. Please be advised that any attempt to check out a student during his/her lunch or athletic period could result in a longer wait or possibly an unsuccessful location of the student. On early release days (12/ 19 /2 5 & 5/2 9 /2 6 ) the cutoff pickup time will be 11:45 AM . Thank you for your patience and understanding. Go Rangers! Hours owed tracking form Attendance Appeal Request Form Frequently Asked Questions At what point does my student owe hours? Any student

who does not attend 90% of the days a class is offered (excused or unexcused) will be required to make-up attendance hours. Hours are calculated by class, by semester. A student cannot miss a class period more than four times per semester. Once a student misses their 5th class period, they owe 1.5 hours for every additional missed class. The following attendance codes generate hours owed: A (Absence-Excused) D (Absence w/Doctor Note-full day) O (Unverified-Unexcused) U (Unexcused) TA (Late to Class, Absent) What is the difference between owing hours and truancy? Owing hours determines whether or not a student received credit for their courses. Truancy determines whether or not a student is meeting the required attendance laws. Where can I go to check if my student owes hours? You can reach out to Joanna Norling or Micah Gillum in the AP office for your hours owed. How does my student

Make up hours? Hours can be made up by: Attending AM or PM Study Halls Attending Saturday School Attendance hours need to be documented on the Attendance Hours Tracking Form . (Forms can also be found in the AP office) Completed forms can be turned in to Joanna Norling or Micah Gillum in the Assistant Principal's office How do I request an appeal? VRHS has an hours owed appeals committee that meets regularly. If your student owes hours for any special circumstances (ie. medical procedures/surgery, etc.), please contact your assistant principal to discuss the process and request an appeals form. Please contact your Assistant Principal with any questions. Vista Ridge High School 200 S.
